daas-irab:12-13.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيراً﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مِنَ الظَّنِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كثيرا. ﴿إِنَّ بَعْضَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿الظَّنِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿إِثْمٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is an explanation of cause (taʿlīl). ﴿وَلا تَجَسَّسُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا يَغْتَبْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the lā of prohibition. ﴿بَعْضُكُمْ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿بَعْضاً﴾ its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَيُحِبُّ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation and rebuke, and a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb. ﴿أَحَدُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an, and its mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَخِيهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. ﴿مَيْتاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (fāʾ of elucidation), and a past verb with its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ); the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ a particle of resumption, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two predicates; the nominal clause is an explanation of cause and has no grammatical position. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾ the i'rab of its like has preceded. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿مِنْ ذَكَرٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَأُنْثى﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ذكر; the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَجَعَلْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿شُعُوباً﴾ its second mafʿūl. ﴿وَقَبائِلَ﴾ conjoined to شعوبا. ﴿لِتَعارَفُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an concealed after the lām of causation, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جعلناكم. ﴿إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَتْقاكُمْ﴾ the khabar of inna; the nominal clause is explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two predicates; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:14-15.t: ﴿قالَتِ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الْأَعْرابُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿قُولُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَسْلَمْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and an imperfect verb, jussive by لما. ﴿الْإِيمانُ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and in is conditional, governing the jussive. ﴿تُطِيعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause تطيعوا is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it. ﴿لا يَلِتْكُمْ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the kāf is its mafʿūl and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ أَعْمالِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two predicates; the clause is an explanation of cause (taʿlīl) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ يَرْتابُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَجاهَدُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿بِأَمْوالِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to أموالهم. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الصَّادِقُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:16-18.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿أَتُعَلِّمُونَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of rebuking interrogation, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِدِينِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَمُنُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. ﴿أَسْلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from an and the verb is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تَمُنُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿إِسْلامَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of saying. ﴿بَلِ﴾ a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَمُنُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يمن. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. ﴿هَداكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl; the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِلْإِيمانِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and what follows it is accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾ conditional, governing the jussive. [Translator's note: the source writes «أن» here; the Quranic word is ﴿إِنْ﴾ (in), the conditional particle.] ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ its khabar; the verbal clause is initial and has no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿غَيْبَ﴾ its mafʿūl. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿بِما﴾ the two are attached to what follows them. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, and the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), and hā is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of أيها. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the vocative clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لا تُقَدِّمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān). ﴿يَدَيِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined to what came before. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (اللَّهِ); as mafʿūl bihi it is اللَّهَ.] ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl). ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَرْفَعُوا﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿أَصْواتَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿صَوْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿النَّبِيِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَجْهَرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِالْقَوْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿كَجَهْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿بَعْضِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِبَعْضٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to jahr. ﴿أَنْ تَحْبَطَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an. ﴿أَعْمالُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation to an omitted mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَشْعُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يَغُضُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَصْواتَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿رَسُولِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause inna is resumptive. ﴿امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿قُلُوبَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلتَّقْوى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of الذين. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَجْرٌ﴾ conjoined to maghfira. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ an adjective; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يُنادُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ وَراءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْحُجُراتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, the nominal clause is the khabar of inna, and the clause inna is resumptive.

daas-irab:5-7.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and law is a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from anna and what follows it is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿تَخْرُجَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after حتى. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to صبروا. ﴿لَكانَ﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of law. ﴿كان﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ its khabar, and the noun of kāna is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khayran; the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿جاءَكُمْ﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فاسِقٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿بِنَبَإٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَتَبَيَّنُوا﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَنْ تُصِيبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from an and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by annexation to an omitted mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being "out of dislike of your striking" (كراهة إصابتكم). ﴿بِجَهالَةٍ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَتُصْبِحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a defective imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نادمين. ﴿فَعَلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of mā. ﴿نادِمِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿رَسُولَ﴾ the postponed noun of anna. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar from anna and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not cause the jussive. ﴿يُطِيعُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي كَثِيرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كثير. ﴿لَعَنِتُّمْ﴾ the lām falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. [Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (اللَّهِ); as the noun of lākinna it is اللَّهَ.] ﴿حَبَّبَ﴾ a past verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar of lākinna. ﴿إِلَيْكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْإِيمانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَزَيَّنَهُ﴾ conjoined to حبب. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَكَرَّهَ﴾ conjoined to zayyana. ﴿إِلَيْكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْكُفْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْفُسُوقَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَالْعِصْيانَ﴾ conjoined to what came before. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الرَّاشِدُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:8-10.t: ﴿فَضْلًا﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضلا. ﴿وَنِعْمَةً﴾ conjoined to فضلا. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and in is conditional. ﴿طائِفَتانِ﴾ the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of طائفتان. ﴿اقْتَتَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the omitted protasis clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَصْلِحُوا﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنْ بَغَتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, in is conditional, and a past verb. ﴿إِحْداهُما﴾ fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى الْأُخْرى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is initial. ﴿فَقاتِلُوا﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿تَبْغِي﴾ an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿حَتَّى تَفِيءَ﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit an after حتى, its fāʿil latent. ﴿إِلى أَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قاتلوا. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ a conjunction, and in is a conditional particle causing the jussive. ﴿فاءَتْ﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَأَصْلِحُوا﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis, and an imperative verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿بِالْعَدْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿وَأَقْسِطُوا﴾ conjoined to أصلحوا. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, with its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl). ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَصْلِحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿أَخَوَيْكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ; the clause is the apodosis of a condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its object. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of لعل, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لا يَسْخَرْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā. ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿عَسى﴾ a complete (tāmm) past verb. ﴿أَنْ يَكُونُوا خَيْراً﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; the wāw is its noun and khayran its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to khayran; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from an and what follows it is the fāʿil of عسى. ﴿وَلا نِساءٌ مِنْ نِساءٍ عَسى أَنْ يَكُنَّ خَيْراً مِنْهُنَّ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and the clause عسى is resumptive. ﴿وَلا تَلْمِزُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the prohibitive lā; the wāw is its fāʿil and anfusakum its object. ﴿وَلا تَنابَزُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِالْأَلْقابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ﴾ an invariable (jāmid) past verb of blame (dhamm), and its fāʿil. ﴿الْفُسُوقُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause بئس is its khabar. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿الْإِيمانِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and man is a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَمْ يَتُبْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by lam, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar, and the clause man is resumptive.
